newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Venture Holdings sells $205 mln 144a debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Venture Holdings sells $205 mln 144a debt.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Venture Holdings Trust was priced on Wednesday via lead manager First Chicago Capital Markets, according to market sources.
The issue priced wider than initial spread talk of 300 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasuries, one high-yield portfolio manager said.
Venture Holdings Trust os a systems integrator, designer, and manufacturer of molded and painted automobile and
industrial parts. It is based in Fraser, Michigan.
